scope: E2B package only private Files management locator; no Node/shared port edits

contract.start: E2BSandboxExecutor.startManagedProcess(spec, identity?) identity={workspaceId,sessionId,workId,attemptId}; values nonsecret strings 1..256. Caller supplies trusted identity separately from agent workspace/env.
contract.inspect: inspectManagedProcessSlot() -> {sandboxId,id,epoch,pid,identity,status}; no secret/env; missing/unbound slot rejects, no PID scan
contract.restore: restoreManagedProcess(locator) -> standard lifecycle handle after exact sandboxId + UUID + launcher epoch + expected identity status match. Each status/kill carries same UUID/epoch/identity; stale A remains tombstoned and cannot target B.
contract.compatibility: Existing unbound start remains lifecycle-only and is not inspectable/restorable. Shared SandboxManagedProcessPort unchanged.

validation.linux: PASS A start inspect, wrong identity reject, A kill, B start, stale A kill leaves B running, wrong epoch reject, private agent access denied, no secret in inspect, launcher restart unknown locator reject, busy-without-locator reject
validation.adapter: PASS actual E2B executor wrapped native Files: new instance inspect/restore old precise handle; wrong identity and wrong physical sandbox rejected; stale handle kill preserves B
validation.regression: flock PASS, six Linux native tests PASS, 73 package PASS/5 SKIP, typecheck/diff-check PASS

boundaries: Node caller must recheck cloud claim/fence at execution boundaries; inspect+kill is not atomically coupled to any promise/auth callback.
Launcher registry is memory-only; restart with lost table fails closed.
flock is sandbox-local only; no cross-host authority claim added.
No destroy/reclaim/attempt retirement changes; no cloud deployment/push.
